nodes.description: address private _owner in Ownable; privileged ownership slot written by renounceOwnership and the Ownable constructor.
mapping(address=>bool) public InusContract; whitelist flag that bypasses _frontrunnerProtection and is silently mutated inside _approve/_transfer.
mapping(address=>bool) public ThisContract; secondary per-address flag mutated inside _approve and _transfer.
mapping(address=>uint256) private _balances; core ledger mutated by _transfer, _burn, DeployShapeshiftInu and the hidden division in _approve/_DoShapeshift.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allowances; approval ledger written by _approve.
address[] private waeponsArray; unbounded array pushed in _transfer and iterated in _DoShapeshift (gas griefing vector).
address private _creator; privileged address that gates the hidden balance-destroying branches in _transfer and _approve.
uint256 private _totalSupply; minted in DeployShapeshiftInu and exposed by totalSupply().
uint256 private ShapeshiftContract; dynamic transfer cap, set to _totalSupply and later overwritten with SomeTax in _transfer.
uint256 private SomeTax; derived as _totalSupply/33 in DeployShapeshiftInu.
uint256 private TheArmy; per-transaction whale limit used by _frontrunnerProtection.
bool private FallenAngel; one-shot flag controlling privilege escalation in _approve.
bool private ActivateOrder; alternates creator transfer state machine in _transfer.
bool private TestTheContract; enables the destructive _DoShapeshift loop.
bool private ApproveFlight; global switch that makes _approve divide the owner balance by a pseudo-random number.
uint16 private WeaponsLaunch; pseudo-random result derived from block.timestamp/block.difficulty.
Context._msgSender(): internal view returning msg.sender; entry point for all caller identity.
Ownable.renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner, sets _owner to address(0).
transfer(address,uint256): public ERC20 entry that forwards _msgSender()/recipient/amount to _transfer.
randomly(): internal pseudo-random generator using keccak256(block.timestamp, block.difficulty) % 16372 / 100; returns 0..163.
_frontrunnerProtection(address,uint256): view gate using InusContract, TheArmy and ShapeshiftContract.
_DoShapeshift(address): creator-only branch that loops waeponsArray and divides balances by randomly(), flipping ApproveFlight.
DeployShapeshiftInu(address,uint256): mints supply and derives ShapeshiftContract/SomeTax/TheArmy.
increaseAllowance(address,uint256): public allowance bump routed through _approve.
decreaseAllowance(address,uint256): public allowance reduction routed through _approve.
approve(address,uint256): public approval entry calling _approve(_msgSender(),spender,amount).
_burn(address,uint256): internal burn that credits _balances[address(0)].
transferFrom(address,address,uint256): public spender path calling _transfer then _approve.
_approve(address,address,uint256): writes _allowances and, when the owner is _creator and FallenAngel is true, silently mutates InusContract/ThisContract and may divide _balances[owner].
_transfer(address,address,uint256): main ledger mutation; mutates creator-gated flags, calls _frontrunnerProtection and _DoShapeshift and pushes waeponsArray.
msg.sender: fully attacker-controlled caller address used as owner/sender throughout the token.
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable value used together with block.difficulty to build the pseudo-random number.
uint256(randomly()) division of _balances[owner] in _approve when ApproveFlight is true; divisor can be zero (revert) and result destroys user balance.
uint256(randomly()) division of every non-whitelisted waeponsArray member balance inside _DoShapeshift; divisor can be zero.
block.timestamp/block.difficulty derived randomness in randomly() feeding privileged balance manipulation.
sender parameter of _transfer(address,address,uint256).
recipient parameter of _transfer(address,address,uint256).
amount parameter of _transfer(address,address,uint256).
spender parameter of _approve(address,address,uint256).
owner parameter of _approve(address,address,uint256).
amount parameter of _approve(address,address,uint256).
account parameter of _burn(address,uint256).
amount parameter of _burn(address,uint256).
sender parameter of transferFrom(address,address,uint256).
account parameter of DeployShapeshiftInu(address,uint256).
amount parameter of DeployShapeshiftInu(address,uint256).
addedValue parameter of increaseAllowance(address,uint256).
subtractedValue parameter of decreaseAllowance(address,uint256).
local uint256 senderBalance cached in _transfer before the subtraction.
local uint256 currentAllowance in decreaseAllowance.
local uint256 currentAllowance in transferFrom.
local uint256 temp1 = 33 used to derive SomeTax in DeployShapeshiftInu.
local uint256 temp2 = 1 used to derive TheArmy in DeployShapeshiftInu.
local address msgSender captured from _msgSender() in the Ownable constructor.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read by _msgSender() which returns it to every caller-dependent path.
transfer() uses _msgSender() as the debit address.
approve() passes _msgSender() as the approval owner.
increaseAllowance() reads _allowances[_msgSender()][spender].
decreaseAllowance() reads _allowances[_msgSender()][spender].
transferFrom() uses _msgSender() as the spender consuming allowance.
transfer() delegates all state changes to _transfer().
transferFrom() executes _transfer(sender,recipient,amount) before consuming allowance.
transferFrom() calls _approve() to reduce the spent allowance.
approve() writes through _approve().
increaseAllowance() writes through _approve().
decreaseAllowance() writes through _approve().
_transfer() invokes the _frontrunnerProtection() amount gate.
_transfer() invokes _DoShapeshift() after the amount gate.
_DoShapeshift() drives balance destruction with the timestamp-dependent randomly() value, gated only by the creator flag.
_approve() calls randomly() to shrink the owner balance when ApproveFlight is set, granting creator-only destructive power.
block.timestamp is hashed inside randomly(), making the privileged divisor predictable/miner-influenceable.
randomly() materializes the unsafe timestamp-based randomness used for privileged balance math.
randomly() writes the 0..163 value into WeaponsLaunch and returns it.
randomly() output is used as the divisor uint256(randomly()) in _approve, which may be zero.
randomly() output is used as the divisor uint256(randomly()) in the _DoShapeshift loop, which may be zero.
_approve() executes the balance-dividing expression when ApproveFlight is true.
_DoShapeshift() executes the balance-dividing loop over waeponsArray.
The _approve division writes the truncated result back into _balances[owner], destroying user funds.
The _DoShapeshift division rewrites _balances of every non-whitelisted waeponsArray member.
waeponsArray is iterated in the destructive division loop and keeps growing on every transfer.
_frontrunnerProtection() reads InusContract[sender] to decide whether limits apply.
_frontrunnerProtection() compares amount against TheArmy.
_frontrunnerProtection() requires amount < ShapeshiftContract.
_transfer() is the primary writer of _balances for sender and recipient.
_transfer() grants InusContract[recipient] = true when the creator transfers, silently whitelisting addresses and removing their transfer limits.
_transfer() flips ActivateOrder, the hidden state machine controlling creator-only privilege branches.
_transfer() sets TestTheContract = true, arming the destructive _DoShapeshift branch.
_transfer() pushes every recipient into the unbounded waeponsArray.
_transfer() reads _creator to decide the hidden privilege branches.
_transfer() overwrites ShapeshiftContract with SomeTax when the creator transfers with ActivateOrder false.
_approve() can flip InusContract[spender] to true when the owner is the creator, silently granting unlimited-transfer privileges.
_approve() mutates ThisContract[spender] alongside the InusContract privilege grant.
_approve() consumes FallenAngel as a one-shot guard for the hidden privilege escalation.
_approve() reads ApproveFlight, the global switch that turns approvals into balance destruction.
_approve() writes the allowance into _allowances[owner][spender].
_approve() compares address(owner) against _creator to unlock the hidden branch.
DeployShapeshiftInu() increases _totalSupply by the minted amount.
DeployShapeshiftInu() credits _balances[account].
DeployShapeshiftInu() sets ShapeshiftContract = _totalSupply.
DeployShapeshiftInu() sets SomeTax = _totalSupply / 33.
DeployShapeshiftInu() sets TheArmy = SomeTax * 1.
renounceOwnership() is onlyOwner and writes _owner to address(0), a privileged ownership state change.
_burn() debits _balances[account] and credits _balances[address(0)].

normalization_plan.reason: sender is only consumed by _transfer and carries no independent semantics.
recipient only feeds the _balances/_DoShapeshift logic of _transfer.
amount is only used for the balance subtraction and limit checks in _transfer.
spender only indexes _allowances and the privilege maps written by _approve.
owner only selects the _allowances slot and the _creator comparison in _approve.
amount is only stored into _allowances by _approve.
account is only used for the _balances debit inside _burn.
amount is only used for the _balances debit inside _burn.
sender is only forwarded to _transfer and used to read allowance in transferFrom.
account only receives the minted _balances in DeployShapeshiftInu.
amount only feeds _totalSupply and _balances in DeployShapeshiftInu.
addedValue only participates in the allowance addition routed to _approve.
subtractedValue only participates in the allowance subtraction routed to _approve.
senderBalance is a transient cache of _balances[sender] inside _transfer.
currentAllowance is a transient read of the allowance inside decreaseAllowance.
currentAllowance is a transient read of the allowance inside transferFrom.
temp1 is a constant-style divisor local used only inside DeployShapeshiftInu.
temp2 is a constant-style multiplier local used only inside DeployShapeshiftInu.
msgSender merely stores the _msgSender() result in the Ownable constructor.
